copy: @ All Access Festival Pass Volunteer at The Film Fest 12 Years of Fierce, Fearless, Independent Film The Ridgway Independent Film Festival (RIFF) returns in 2026 with its 12th year of celebrating bold storytelling, emerging filmmakers, and the power of community through the lens of independent film. The RIFF committee has selected films with a lineup of 6 blocks of films spanning 3 days. View Digital Program, tickets and more. Individual Block Tickets: $15 All Access Festival Pass: $75 Rooted in a volunteer-driven, grassroots effort born shortly after Ridgway became one of Colorado’s first Certified Creative Districts, RIFF continues to evolve while honoring its origins. This year, RIFF returns to its longtime home in November, taking place November 13–15, 2026, with a refreshed structure designed to create deeper connection and conversation. …

Doors:  9:45 am || Film start: 10:00 am ||  Single Block General Admission:  $15



Something Was Calling Us



Sooner or later, a voice asks us to listen. It may carry a memory, a lost love, an echo of someone gone, or the hope of finding our way back. Wistful, tender, and occasionally strange, these stories follow the quiet pull of love, loss, identity, and change—and the unexpected paths we take toward what is missing.

The places we pass through remember more than we do. Rooted across Colorado, these documentaries explore the ties between people and place—the histories we inherit, the traditions we carry, the communities that raise us, and the paths we choose for ourselves.

We Gathered Around the Fire



So we sit together and share what we have carried. Look closely enough, and even a mailbox has a story. These films find community in the ordinary places where lives intersect—in neighbors, shared spaces, small gestures, and the things we build together. Come gather for a while. You may leave dancing.

Come for the weird. Stay for the dark. And maybe don’t ask what’s for dinner.

By morning, the world is no simpler—only larger. These stories move between truth and memory, expectation and identity, the lives we’re given and the ones we make for ourselves. Tender, tense, funny, and quietly unsettling, they inhabit the gray areas—where things get complicated and perhaps a little more human.

title: The Sherbino & Citizens State Bank Present: Winter Wildlands Alliance BACKCOUNTRY FILM FEST
copy: Winter Wildlands presents the Backcountry Film Festival at the Sherbino—an inspiring night of human-powered adventure and winter storytelling. ❄️🎬 📅 November 18, 2026 | Doors 6 PM • Films 6:30 PM @ TICKETS The Sherbino and CSB Present: Winter Wildlands Alliance Backcountry Film Festival Doors: 6:00pm || Films: 6:30pm || $10 students and seniors (18-/ 65+) || $15 General Admission The Backcountry Film Festival, presented by Winter Wildlands Alliance, celebrates the power and spirit of humans in winter. Since its inception, the festival has toured across states, countries—even Antarctica—screening hundreds of inspiring films that celebrate adventure, conservation, and the magic of winter. Over the years, the festival has raised millions of dollars to support local projects that strengthen winter communities and protect our wild snowscapes. The 2026-27 winter season is the 22nd Anniversary of the Backcountry Film Festival! …

title: Noel Night Gift to the Community! THE HIP SNACKS
copy: @ Doors: 8 || Show: 8:30 || $ entry by donation || Made possible with support from Ouray County Performing Arts Guild and generous community members Setting: Standing Noel Night – Free Show! Featuring The Hip Snacks The Ouray County Performing Arts Guild and The Sherbino’s annual gift to the community returns this Noel Night with a free, feel-good evening of live music featuring Denver-based rock-n-soul powerhouse The Hip Snacks. Blending soul, rock, pop, jam, and hip-hop influences, The Hip Snacks have built a reputation for high-energy performances driven by fiery guitar work, irresistible grooves, and the towering vocals of lead singer Kara Durante. Fresh from their second national tour and the release of their new album, Out On A Limb, the six-piece band is quickly moving from Colorado favorite to a must-see act on stages across the country. …

title: Family Gingerbread House Decorating
copy:
@ 			
			
							
		
			





TICKETS




A Ouray County Holiday Tradition!



Family Gingerbread House DecoratingSaturday, 10:00am-Noon (all ages!)Sherbino Ridgway$20 per gingerbread house



Get cozy and join us for our annual gingerbread house decorating event! Picture buckets of candy, oodles of frosting, sticky fingers, heaps of smiles, and a kajillion sugar-coated photo ops. Bring your favorite grown-up(s) to decorate your very own sweet gingerbread house. After check-in, you'll find fully assembled houses ready for the magic of your imagination and decoration. Browse tables filled with candy and goodies to embellish your creations with plenty of frosting, then take your house home to enjoy during the holiday season. 



Please sign up in advance to secure your gingerbread house! Walk-ins are welcome until we reach capacity. Doors open at 10 AM.
